lines.say: Does magnesium fix your cramps and your sleep?
Magnesium helps your muscles relax, your nerves fire, and your cells make energy. You do need it.
So people take it for cramps. But a big Cochrane review found it's unlikely to help typical muscle cramps.
For performance, extra magnesium seems to help mainly people who are low to begin with.
Many people do eat less than they should. Nuts, seeds, beans, dark greens and whole grains are full of it.
Supplements can upset your stomach. Kidney problems? Ask a doctor first.
